# One cross-asset risk platform replaces 21 legacy systems with zero service disruption


[Prashant Gandhi](https://www.griddynamics.com/author/prashant-gandhi)


[Henry Garner](https://www.griddynamics.com/author/henry-garner)


A bank’s edge depends on knowing its risk in real time, across every asset class and region. At this Tier 1 investment bank, market risk ran on spreadsheets and 21 legacy systems that no one fully understood. Nobody could point to a single trusted view of exposure.


[JUXT, a Grid Dynamics company](https://www.griddynamics.com/press-releases/grid-dynamics-expands-global-footprint-with-juxt-acquisition) , built a[cross-asset trade and risk platform](https://www.griddynamics.com/industries/financial-services) and used it to retire all 21 systems, one by one, without losing a trading day.


The core is trade- and model-agnostic. It asks the bank’s quant libraries what they need and builds a dependency graph, so quants change models without touching the risk system. Every input is stored with its result. That leaves more than 7 years of replayable history for FRTB, model validation, and dispute questions.


Today, the platform values around 4 million trades a day and produces more than 4 billion risk results. More than 700 traders, risk managers, and regulators work from one source of truth. It has run in production for over 10 years, with zero service disruptions.


Planning your own legacy risk retirement? Read the full case study, then explore Grid Dynamics[cloud platform and product engineering services](https://www.griddynamics.com/services/cloud-platform-and-product-engineering) or a guide to[legacy system modernization](https://www.griddynamics.com/glossary/legacy-system-modernization) .
